The '''Tselgormet Prize''' was an award given for exceptional cooking. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] chef [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] was awarded the Tselgormet Prize five years running.
